subject: EverCo SIG mapping & evidence request
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@evercommerce.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evercommerce.com
Date: 2028-07-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: EverCo — SIG mapping and evidence request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our vendor assurance review (we're moving to final vendor selection this quarter), Procurement and InfoSec at EverCo need a SIG questionnaire mapping and an initial evidence bundle for a subset of controls so we can complete our internal risk assessment.

Scope / asks (high level):
- Completed SIG matrix (template attached) mapping Redwood controls to SIG sections we flagged: CC6 (Change Management), CC7 (Configuration & Hardening), CC9 (Data Encryption & Key Management).
- Evidence samples for the controls above (logs, screenshots, policy excerpts, configuration export, and a signed SOC 2 report if available).
- Short control narratives (1–3 paragraphs) per control that explain how Redwood meets the requirement — we may include these verbatim in our audit packet.

Deadline: can you get the mapping + initial evidence set by close of business 2028-07-06? If you need a longer runway we can negotiate but we'd prefer a 5-business-day turnaround.

Attached: EverCo_SIG_Request_20280701.pdf (RFP excerpt + highlighted controls).

Let me know who on your side will own the delivery and whether you prefer secure transfer (we use ShareFile).

Best,
Sara Liu
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
EverCommerce

--
Attachment: EverCo_SIG_Request_20280701.pdf (pdf, 523 KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@evercommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EverCo — SIG mapping and evidence request

Hi Sara — thanks, appreciate the clear ask.

I'm looping in Mina (security engineering) and Marissa (sales lead) who'll coordinate the evidence pull and logistics. Proposed plan:
1) We’ll produce a completed SIG mapping spreadsheet (Redwood_SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx) that points to the exact artifacts.
2) Mina will assemble redacted artifacts and an evidence manifest; we will deliver via a secure ShareFile link and provide a short control narrative bundle for the three controls.
3) If EverCo requires the full SOC 2 report with a non-disclosure in place, we can provide that under NDA — let us know the contacts and we’ll expedite.

Target: mapping + a first tranche of evidence (config exports + logging screenshots + policy excerpts) by EOD 2028-07-06. We will flag anything that needs additional time.

I attached a lightweight tracker template (sig_artifact_tracker_template.csv) we’ll use internally; I’ll share the completed mapping when ready.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0137

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@evercommerce.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EverCo — SIG mapping and evidence request

Ben / Marissa / Sara — I’ll own the technical evidence collection. Quick notes on scope and what we can reliably deliver by 2028-07-06:

Deliverables (initial tranche):
- SIG mapping spreadsheet with direct artifact references (Redwood_SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx).
- Evidence manifest (evidence_manifest_v1.txt) describing each artifact, collection method, and redaction status.
- Sample artifacts: configuration export for inference fleet (k8s manifests and nginx config), access-control policy screenshots (IAM console), KMS key metadata export, CloudWatch log snippets showing rotation/alerting for API errors.
- Short control narratives for CC6/CC7/CC9 (we'll draft, attach as rdwd_control_narratives_CC7.docx for CC7 and similarly inline for others).

Artifacts we will NOT include in the first tranche (need legal/ops approval or redaction work):
- Raw PII-containing logs (we will provide redacted extracts).
- HSM key material dumps (we will provide KMS metadata and key rotation policy).

Collection plan / locations:
- Soc2 report (if acceptable under NDA) will be pulled from secure GDrive: https://redwood.shareddrive.internal/assurance/soc2/2027_report.pdf
- Evidence bundle will be staged in a temporary secure bucket and delivered via ShareFile link.
- Internal ticket for artifact pulls: SEC-1193 (tracking).

Security notes: all artifacts will be redacted for customer PII and signed-off by the security manager before leaving our environment. We will include checksums and an evidence_manifest_v1.txt file listing hashes and collection timestamps.

Sara — can you confirm whether EverCo prefers a ShareFile transfer or an SFTP endpoint? Also, does your procurement/legal team need an executed NDA before we include the SOC 2 PDF?

Mina Haddad
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.txt (text, 5 KB)
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@evercommerce.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EverCo — SIG mapping and evidence request

Thanks Mina — that plan works for us. ShareFile is preferred for the initial tranche; we will provide an SFTP target if later needed.

NDA / SOC 2: procurement can accept a limited-use access NDA — I’ve looped in our legal contact (procurement@evercommerce.com). Please mark the SOC 2 PDF as Confidential and we will execute the NDA electronically; once signed we will confirm where to place it in our system.

Control narrative ask: for CC7 (configuration & hardening) our audit team would like a concise narrative (3–4 short paragraphs) that we can attach to the SIG mapping. If possible please include the following in that narrative: baseline hardening policy reference, automated drift detection tools you run, frequency of patch cycles, and any compensating controls for ephemeral workloads.

If you hit any blockers on access to artifacts by EOD 2028-07-06 let me know — we can extend to the 9th but prefer not to.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Sara Liu
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
EverCommerce
